ModInfo.Name: FF8 Steam Deck Button Glyphs
ModInfo.Author: todi
ModInfo.Description:
Shows the Steam Deck / Steam Controller buttons (A, B, X, Y, L1/R1, L2/R2, View, Menu) wherever FF8 names a button, instead of "B1", "B2", ... The icons follow your button setup from the in-game Config menu.
Works with FF8 on Steam (2013 or Remastered) with Junction VIII, in every game language.
Using AxlRose's mod with its UI? Place this mod above it in the list.
ModInfo.ReleaseNotes: 1.10: works in every game language, including Japanese, and with the low-res icons; smaller download. 1.00: new preview image. 0.9: button glyphs are smaller and sharp-edged, so they no longer overlap the next line of text; Auto Sort now places this mod above AxlRose's mod. 0.8: textures only, the Timber train keypad fix (DLL) is removed. 0.7: first public release.
